e.title: 无标签的理赔异常检测：把规则引擎留作弱标签基准，并明说该基准衡量的是「一致与不一致」而非准确率
e.title_en: Label-free claim anomaly detection: the rule engine is held out as a weak-label benchmark, and the benchmark is explicitly said to measure agreement and disagreement rather than accuracy
e.title_hk: 無標籤的理賠異常檢測：把規則引擎留作弱標籤基準，並明說該基準衡量的是「一致與不一致」而非準確率
e.summary: 一个在 R 中搭建的无监督理赔异常检测流水线：用 AIDA 打异常分、用 TIX 把分数归因到具体特征，让每个被标记的理赔都带一份「它哪里不寻常」的排序清单；它不依赖任何已标注的欺诈数据，把保险公司现有的规则引擎刻意排除在特征矩阵之外、仅作弱标签基准，并明确说明该基准衡量的是两种系统的一致与不一致而非准确率
e.summary_hk: 一個在 R 中搭建的無監督理賠異常檢測流水線：用 AIDA 打異常分、用 TIX 把分數歸因到具體特徵，讓每個被標記的理賠都帶一份「它哪裡不尋常」的排序清單；它不依賴任何已標註的欺詐資料，把保險公司現有的規則引擎刻意排除在特徵矩陣之外、僅作弱標籤基準，並明確說明該基準衡量的是兩種系統的一致與不一致而非準確率
e.summary_en: An unsupervised claim anomaly detection pipeline built in R: AIDA produces the anomaly scores and TIX attributes each score across input features, so every flagged claim carries a ranked list of what made it unusual; it relies on no labelled fraud data, deliberately keeps the insurer’s existing rule engine out of the feature matrix and uses it only as a weak-label benchmark, and states explicitly that the benchmark measures agreement and disagreement rather than accuracy
e.body:
**aida-tix-anomaly-detection** 是一个**在 R 中搭建的无监督车险理赔异常检测流水线**（仓库 `aay-shar/aida-tix-anomaly-detection`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 R、仓库体量 273 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-07**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库根目录**没有许可文件**（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404），**而其 README 末节却逐字写着「## Licence — MIT — see `LICENSE`.」**（**详见下方标注 ①**）；**无 topics**；**README 实测 8,502 字节**。本条目属于本轮主题**「说清楚什么算它是对的」**中的**第二种，也是把「这套检验能证明什么」写得最精确的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**README 标题逐字为「Explainable Anomaly Detection for Motor Insurance Claims」**，**副题逐字为「An unsupervised pipeline that ranks motor insurance claims by how unusual they are, and explains each ranking at the level of individual features — **without any labelled fraud data**.」**；**其来历逐字为**：**「Built in R as an **MSc thesis project (Applied Data Science, Utrecht University)**, in collaboration with **an actuarial consultancy working with a motor insurer in Asia**.」**。**根目录实测**：**`.gitignore`、`R/`、`README.md`（8,502 字节）、`config_example.R`（180 字节）、`data/`、`figures/`**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「把规则引擎排除在特征矩阵之外、只当弱标签基准」是本条目最重要也最值得学的一处**——**逐字为**：**「The insurer’s existing rule engine is the only external signal available, so it serves as a **weak-label benchmark** — and **is deliberately held out of the model entirely. The rules table is never joined into the feature matrix.** This matters: **if the model can see which rules fired, "does the model agree with the rules" stops being a question worth asking.**」**——**即「保险公司现有的规则引擎是唯一可用的外部信号，因此它充当**弱标签基准**——并且**被刻意完全排除在模型之外，规则表从不并入特征矩阵**。这一点很重要：**如果模型能看到哪些规则被触发，『模型是否与规则一致』就不再是一个值得问的问题了』」**。⭐⭐⭐ **这是本会话见到对**评估泄漏**讲得最清楚的一段**：**把评估基准喂进模型，会让评估退化为同义反复**（**可与第 330 轮 [[catrisk-sim]] 的「测试不变量」、第 329 轮 [[insurance-tabular-review]] 的「引证校验」并读**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「该基准衡量的是**一致与不一致**而非准确率」是本条目的第二处精确表述**——**逐字为**：**「A rule firing is **not ground truth either** — it doesn’t prove fraud, and fraud can occur with no rule firing — so the benchmark measures ***agreement and disagreement*, not accuracy**.」**——**即「规则被触发也**不是真值**——它不能证明欺诈，而欺诈也可能在没有任何规则触发时发生——所以该基准衡量的是**一致与不一致**，而**不是准确率**」**。⭐⭐ **对做欺诈模型的学生，这句话直接拆掉了**「用规则标签训练并报告 AUC」这一常见做法的正当性****。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **其问题陈述把「为什么不能用监督学习」讲成了一个具体的数据事实，而非泛泛而谈**——**逐字为**：**「Insurers investigating irregular claims usually rely on a **rule engine**: a fixed set of thresholds written by domain experts. Rules are transparent and cheap to run, but **they only catch what someone thought to write down**, and they say nothing about claims that are strange in ways nobody anticipated.」**，**并接**：**「The obvious alternative is supervised learning — except that **requires labels, and confirmed-fraud labels barely exist**. Investigations are expensive, most claims are never examined, and **a claim that was never investigated isn’t a negative example. Any model trained on that data learns which claims got looked at, not which claims were fraudulent.**」**——⭐⭐⭐ **最后一句是选择偏差在欺诈建模中的经典陷阱，此处表述得极为干净**（**可与 [[explainable-ai-fraud]]、[[ifraudsimulator]]、[[networkfraud]]、[[insurance-conformal-fraud]]、[[medical-insurance-fraud-tianchi]] 并读**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「没有解释的分数不可执行」是本条目对**可解释性**给出的实用理由**——**逐字为**：**「produce a reason for each ranking specific enough that an adjuster can act on it. **A score with no explanation is not actionable — nobody opens an investigation because a number was high.**」**——**即「**没有人会因为一个数字很高就去开一个调查**」**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **「Findings」一节里留着**未对账的占位符**——这是本条目必须如实指出的一处**——**逐字为**：**「> **Note:** figures below are **placeholders pending a final reconciliation pass** — fill in from the thesis before publishing. See "Open items" at the bottom.」**，**其相关一处逐字为**：**「Spearman rank correlation between AIDA and Isolation Forest across all claims is ρ ≈ `[0.27 / 0.29 — reconcile]`」**——⭐⭐⭐ **即**README 尚处草稿状态，部分数值明确标注为待填、且有一个值写成待对账的二选一****。**这意味着本词条**不得把该节的任何数字当作结论引用****；**本词条据此**不主张**这些数值**（**⚠️ 这是本会话首次遇到**作者把「此处数值未定」直接留在公开 README 里**的情形**——**与第 328 轮 [[creance]] 的「调度器只打印计划」、第 330 轮 [[actuary-os]] 的薄 README 同属**把未完成状态写在明面上**，但本条更具体到单个数值**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **其三项发现即便在占位状态下，论证结构也是完整的，且都指向「不要把它当权威」**：(a) **「两种检测器几乎完全不一致」**——**逐字含「only one claim appears in both methods’ top 100」**，**并解释为「**This is a property of the algorithm family, not a defect**」**，**结论逐字为「It does mean that **a single unsupervised detector should not be treated as authoritative**.」**；(b) **「AIDA 与规则引擎相互独立，而非其替代」**——**逐字含「AUC against the held-out rules is ≈ 0.46 — **essentially no separation** — and **28 of AIDA’s top 100 claims fired no rule at all**」**，**并逐字给出解读**：**「**Read as accuracy that looks like failure. Read correctly, it’s the point**: the two systems are picking up different things, so AIDA’s value is as a **complement that surfaces claims the rules structurally cannot**.」**⭐⭐ **这是一处**主动把不利指标解释成预期结果**的写法**——**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该解读一定成立**（**「AUC 0.46」在字面上确实接近无区分度**）；**本词条只记录作者的论证与理由**；(c) **「缺失本身携带信号」**——**逐字含 TIX 归因拆分为「roughly **60% to one-hot categoricals, 26% to missingness indicator flags, and 13% to numeric features**」**，**并说明「**which fields are blank** on a claim turns out to be informative, which is why the pipeline encodes missingness explicitly rather than imputing it away」**（**⚠️ 同样属待对账的占位数值**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **八步流水线逐字实测，其中数步是专业做法**：**① 载入与清洗**（把 `""`、`"NA"`、`"NULL"`、`"?"` 等哨兵值转为真正的 `NA`，**以便缺失可被度量**）；**② 筛选**（仅取最新流程阶段、仅车险理赔，**把同一案件的多个快照收敛到最新一条，而把修订历史保留为工程特征而非丢弃**）；**③ 按策略丢弃**（直接标识符、自由文本，以及**会泄漏模型本应看不到的结案信息的「事后结果字段」，如理赔状态与已付金额**）；**④ 聚合子表**（配件价差、工时合计、既往理赔次数与近因）；**⑤ 构造特征**（**报案延迟、进入保单天数、临近保单起止的理赔、出险时车龄、估损修订比**）；**⑥ 编码缺失**（字段按「多数存在／多数缺失／变动」分档，各生成显式指示列）；**⑦ 构造矩阵**（**金额字段取对数、稳健中位数／IQR 缩放、低基数类别独热编码、超过 25 个水平用频率编码、稀有水平合并**）；**⑧ 打分与解释**（导出给 AIDA 二进制、读回分数、导出 top-k 给 TIX、读回归因并映射到特征名）**。⭐ **其中第 ③ 步的「排除事后结果字段以防泄漏」与第 ⑤ 步的「把快照修订史留下当特征」都属**知道自己在防什么的特征工程****。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **每个特征都带一条 manifest 记录，这是 TIX 归因能拆解的前提**——**逐字为**：**「Every feature carries a **manifest entry** recording whether it came from a numeric field, a one-hot level, a frequency encoding, or a missingness flag — **which is what makes the TIX attribution breakdown above possible**.」**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **数据与可运行性的交代极为诚实，是本条目在**可复现性**上最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「The claims data is **proprietary and is not included** in this repository. **No data file, no derived export, and no per-claim output is committed. The country and the insurer are not identified.** `config.R`, which holds local paths, is gitignored. **The code is published to show the method and the engineering; it will not run without access to the underlying data.**」**——**即「理赔数据属专有且未包含在本仓库中；**没有提交任何数据文件、任何派生导出或任何逐笔输出；国家与保险公司均未标识****；**代码公开是为了展示方法与工程，**没有底层数据则无法运行****」**。⭐⭐ **明确写出「外部人跑不起来」，比静默缺失数据有用得多**（**可与第 330 轮 [[catrisk-sim]] 的「synthetic and deliberately simplified」、第 325 轮 [[parametric-risk-toolkit]] 的固定种子合成数据并读——**三者都在处理**数据不能公开时怎么办**，**各选了不同解法**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **AIDA 与 TIX 明确声明**未随仓库分发****——**逐字为「**AIDA and TIX are not redistributed here.** Obtain the implementation from the authors’ release for the paper cited below, and build it locally」**，**并给出 `g++` 构建命令**；**且 `R/00_run_all.R` 逐字标注了**两处为外部二进制而暂停**的位置**。**⑪ ⭐ **参考文献与致谢逐字实测**：**Souto Arias, L. A., Oosterlee, C. W., & Cirillo, P. (2023). AIDA: Analytic isolation and distance-based anomaly detection algorithm. Pattern Recognition, 141, 109607.**；**致谢为「Supervised by Dr. Georg Krempl (Utrecht University), with industry supervision from the partner consultancy.」**。**⑫ ⭐ **Isolation Forest 作为基线时**刻意设置 `ndim = 1`**，**逐字解释为「so the comparison is against **classic axis-parallel isolation** rather than an oblique variant」**——**即把基线的配置也交代清楚，以免比较对象不明**。**⑬ ⭐ 可与本站欺诈与异常检测条目并读**：[[explainable-ai-fraud]]、[[ifraudsimulator]]、[[networkfraud]]、[[insurance-conformal-fraud]]、[[medical-insurance-fraud-tianchi]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]、[[fraud-detection]]、[[insurance-anam]]、[[insurance-cv]]、[[ins-mmbench]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可情形**：**GitHub API 许可字段实测为 `NONE`**，**根目录实测无许可文件**（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 **404**）；**而 README 末节逐字为「## Licence — MIT — see `LICENSE`.」**——**即声称 MIT 并指向一个不存在的文件**。**本词条明确记录这一**声明与实际不一致**的情况**（**⚠️ 这与第 330 轮 [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、本轮 [[insurers-101]] 与 [[insurerisk]] 属同一类，**本轮四条中有三条如此****）；**使用、修改或再分发其代码前必须自行确认授权状况**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、仓库根目录清单、README（8,502 字节）全文（含问题陈述、方法、Findings 及各节的逐字表述、八步流水线、仓库布局、运行方式、数据节、参考文献、致谢与许可声明）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装 R 或其依赖、未运行 `00_run_all.R` 或任何一个脚本、**未取得、未构建、未运行 AIDA 与 TIX 的 C++ 二进制**、未读 `R/` 下任何脚本源码、未查看 `figures/` 或 `data/`、未读其学位论文****，因此**不能转述其 AIDA 与 TIX 的调用细节、特征构造的具体实现、参数设置或其论文结论**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **Findings 一节明确带有**占位符提示**（逐字「figures below are placeholders pending a final reconciliation pass — fill in from the thesis before publishing」），**且其中一处数值逐字写成待对账的二选一 `[0.27 / 0.29 — reconcile]`****——**本词条据此**不把该节任何数字当作结论**，**该节内容仅作为**作者的论证结构与解读方式**记录**；**具体数值须以论文定稿为准，****本次未读论文**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「AIDA 与 Isolation Forest 两种检测器结论几乎完全不一致」以及「AUC ≈ 0.46」等陈述**——**本次完全未运行**；**作者对「AUC 0.46 应解读为互补而非失败」的解释已被本词条如实记录为**作者的解释**，**本词条**不主张**该解释一定成立**（**0.46 字面上接近无区分度**）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其八步流水线中「排除事后结果字段以防泄漏」与「保留快照修订史为特征」在实际实现中是否如其所述**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其「缺失本身携带信号」这一发现的稳健性**（**缺失率与理赔流程本身相关，可能反映的是**案件处理路径**而非欺诈风险**；**此为本词条的提示性判断，非作者自述**）；**⑦ ⭐ **未核实** `data/` 目录中实际含有何种内容**（**README 称未提交任何数据文件与派生导出，**本词条**不主张**该目录为空或其他**——**本次未列出其内容**）；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**其与「一家亚洲车险公司」及那家精算咨询公司的合作关系的具体情况**（**README 未披露机构名称，**本词条**不主张**可核实**）；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **欺诈检测在多数辖区涉及**对个人的自动化判断与相应的程序与合规要求****；**本词条**不主张**该流水线在任何辖区可用于实际的调查决策、理赔处理或对个人的不利行动**（**其自身定位是给理赔人员提供**待查线索**，**而非结论**）；**⑩ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建与推送同日**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其方法优越性或已被采用**；**⑪ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑫ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/aay-shar/aida-tix-anomaly-detection`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 8,502 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对，含问题陈述、弱标签基准与「一致与不一致而非准确率」两句、Findings 占位符提示、八步流水线、数据节免责句、参考文献与许可声明）；`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404；**未克隆、未运行、未构建其 C++ 二进制、未读其论文**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫根目錄實測**）：**標題逐字「Explainable Anomaly Detection for Motor Insurance Claims」**，**副題逐字「An unsupervised pipeline that ranks motor insurance claims by how unusual they are, and explains each ranking at the level of individual features — **without any labelled fraud data**.」**；**來歷逐字**：**「Built in R as an **MSc thesis project (Applied Data Science, Utrecht University)**, in collaboration with **an actuarial consultancy working with a motor insurer in Asia**.」**。**根目錄實測**：**`.gitignore`、`R/`、`README.md`（8,502）、`config_example.R`（180）、`data/`、`figures/`**。

e.body_en:
**aida-tix-anomaly-detection** is **an unsupervised motor-claim anomaly detection pipeline built in R** (repository `aay-shar/aida-tix-anomaly-detection`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, R as the primary language, a 273 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-07** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository has no licence file at the root (`LICENSE` measured 404 on main), yet its README closes with the verbatim line "## Licence — MIT — see `LICENSE`."** (**see note ① below**); it has **no topics**; **the README measures 8,502 bytes**. It is the second of this round’s four takes on **stating what would count as evidence that it is right**, **and the one that states most precisely what its check does and does not establish**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): **the README title reads verbatim "Explainable Anomaly Detection for Motor Insurance Claims"**, **with the subtitle reading verbatim "An unsupervised pipeline that ranks motor insurance claims by how unusual they are, and explains each ranking at the level of individual features — without any labelled fraud data."**; **its provenance reads verbatim**: **"Built in R as an MSc thesis project (Applied Data Science, Utrecht University), in collaboration with an actuarial consultancy working with a motor insurer in Asia."** **The root measurably contains** **`.gitignore`, `R/`, `README.md` (8,502 bytes), `config_example.R` (180 bytes), `data/` and `figures/`**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Holding the rule engine out of the feature matrix and using it only as a weak-label benchmark is the entry’s most important and most instructive point** — verbatim: **"The insurer’s existing rule engine is the only external signal available, so it serves as a weak-label benchmark — and is deliberately held out of the model entirely. The rules table is never joined into the feature matrix. This matters: if the model can see which rules fired, \"does the model agree with the rules\" stops being a question worth asking."** ⭐⭐⭐ **This is the clearest statement of evaluation leakage this session has seen: feeding the benchmark into the model degrades the evaluation into a tautology** (**readable with round 330’s [[catrisk-sim]] and round 329’s [[insurance-tabular-review]]**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ That the benchmark measures agreement and disagreement rather than accuracy is its second precise formulation** — verbatim: **"A rule firing is not ground truth either — it doesn’t prove fraud, and fraud can occur with no rule firing — so the benchmark measures agreement and disagreement, not accuracy."** ⭐⭐ **For a student building a fraud model, that sentence removes the justification for the common practice of training on rule labels and reporting AUC.** **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its problem statement turns "why supervised learning is not available" into a concrete data fact rather than a general remark** — verbatim: **"Insurers investigating irregular claims usually rely on a rule engine: a fixed set of thresholds written by domain experts. Rules are transparent and cheap to run, but they only catch what someone thought to write down, and they say nothing about claims that are strange in ways nobody anticipated."**, **followed by**: **"The obvious alternative is supervised learning — except that requires labels, and confirmed-fraud labels barely exist. Investigations are expensive, most claims are never examined, and a claim that was never investigated isn’t a negative example. Any model trained on that data learns which claims got looked at, not which claims were fraudulent."** ⭐⭐⭐ **That last sentence is the classic selection-bias trap in fraud modelling, stated very cleanly** (**readable with [[explainable-ai-fraud]], [[ifraudsimulator]], [[networkfraud]], [[insurance-conformal-fraud]] and [[medical-insurance-fraud-tianchi]]**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ "A score with no explanation is not actionable" is the entry’s practical argument for explainability** — verbatim: **"produce a reason for each ranking specific enough that an adjuster can act on it. A score with no explanation is not actionable — nobody opens an investigation because a number was high."** **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its Findings section still carries unreconciled placeholders — a point this entry must state plainly** — verbatim: **"> Note: figures below are placeholders pending a final reconciliation pass — fill in from the thesis before publishing. See \"Open items\" at the bottom."**, **with one value reading verbatim as "ρ ≈ `[0.27 / 0.29 — reconcile]`"** — ⭐⭐⭐ **so the README is explicitly in draft state, some figures are marked pending and one is written as an unresolved choice of two**; **the entry therefore does not treat any figure in that section as a conclusion** (**⚠️ this is the first time this session has seen an author leave "this number is not settled yet" in a public README — the same instinct as round 328’s [[creance]] and round 330’s [[actuary-os]], but taken down to an individual value**). **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Its three findings have a complete argument structure even in placeholder state, and all three point away from treating it as authoritative**: (a) **"The two detectors disagree almost completely"** — verbatim that **only one claim appears in both methods’ top 100**, explained verbatim as **"This is a property of the algorithm family, not a defect"**, concluding verbatim that **"a single unsupervised detector should not be treated as authoritative"**; (b) **AIDA is independent of the rule engine rather than a replacement** — verbatim that **AUC against the held-out rules is ≈ 0.46, "essentially no separation"**, and that **28 of AIDA’s top 100 claims fired no rule at all**, read verbatim as **"Read as accuracy that looks like failure. Read correctly, it’s the point"** ⭐⭐ **a case of actively interpreting an unfavourable metric as the expected result** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim that reading must hold — 0.46 is literally close to no discrimination**); (c) **"Missingness carries signal"** — verbatim that TIX attribution splits **"roughly 60% to one-hot categoricals, 26% to missingness indicator flags, and 13% to numeric features"** (**⚠️ likewise a placeholder figure pending reconciliation**). **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ Its eight-step pipeline reads verbatim, several steps being professional practice**: **① load and clean** (sentinel values `""`, `"NA"`, `"NULL"`, `"?"` converted to real `NA` **so missingness is measurable**); **② filter** (latest workflow stage only, car claims only, **collapsing multiple snapshots per case to the most recent while retaining the revision history as engineered features rather than discarding it**); **③ drop by policy** (direct identifiers, free text, and **post-hoc outcome fields such as claim status and amounts paid that would leak the resolution the model is supposed to be blind to**); **④ aggregate children** (parts price discrepancies, labour totals, prior-claim counts and recency); **⑤ engineer features** (**reporting delay, days into policy, claims near policy start or end, vehicle age at loss, estimate revision ratios**); **⑥ encode missingness**; **⑦ build the matrix** (**log transform on monetary fields, robust median/IQR scaling, one-hot for low-cardinality categoricals, frequency encoding above 25 levels, rare levels collapsed**); **⑧ score and explain**. **⑧ ⭐⭐ Every feature carries a manifest entry, which is what makes the TIX breakdown possible** — verbatim: **"Every feature carries a manifest entry recording whether it came from a numeric field, a one-hot level, a frequency encoding, or a missingness flag — which is what makes the TIX attribution breakdown above possible."** **⑨ ⭐⭐ Its handling of data and runnability is unusually honest, the entry’s most notable point on reproducibility** — verbatim: **"The claims data is proprietary and is not included in this repository. No data file, no derived export, and no per-claim output is committed. The country and the insurer are not identified. `config.R`, which holds local paths, is gitignored. The code is published to show the method and the engineering; it will not run without access to the underlying data."** ⭐⭐ **Stating outright that outsiders cannot run it is far more useful than silently omitting the data** (**readable with round 330’s [[catrisk-sim]] and round 325’s [[parametric-risk-toolkit]] — three different answers to the same problem of undisclosable data**). **⑩ ⭐⭐ AIDA and TIX are explicitly stated not to be redistributed** — verbatim **"AIDA and TIX are not redistributed here."** with `g++` build commands — **and `R/00_run_all.R` marks verbatim the two points where the pipeline pauses for the external binaries**. **⑪ ⭐ Its reference reads verbatim**: **Souto Arias, L. A., Oosterlee, C. W., & Cirillo, P. (2023). AIDA: Analytic isolation and distance-based anomaly detection algorithm. Pattern Recognition, 141, 109607.**; **and the acknowledgements name Dr. Georg Krempl (Utrecht University)**. **⑫ ⭐ The Isolation Forest baseline is deliberately configured with `ndim = 1`**, **explained verbatim as "so the comparison is against classic axis-parallel isolation rather than an oblique variant"**. **⑬ ⭐ Readable with the site’s fraud and anomaly detection entries**: [[explainable-ai-fraud]], [[ifraudsimulator]], [[networkfraud]], [[insurance-conformal-fraud]], [[medical-insurance-fraud-tianchi]], [[claims-fraud-guardian]], [[insurance-anam]], [[insurance-cv]] and [[ins-mmbench]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ Licence situation**: **the GitHub API licence field measurably reads `NONE`** and **the root listing contains no licence file** (`LICENSE` measured **404** on main), **while the README’s closing section reads verbatim "## Licence — MIT — see `LICENSE`."** — **a claim of MIT pointing at a file that does not exist**; **the entry records this mismatch explicitly** (**⚠️ the same class as round 330’s [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]] and this round’s [[insurers-101]] and [[insurerisk]] — three of this round’s four**); **authorisation must be confirmed before using, modifying or redistributing the code**; **②** this check verified **the repository metadata, the root listing, and the README’s full 8,502 bytes including its problem statement, approach, Findings, eight-step pipeline, repository layout, running instructions, data section, reference, acknowledgements and licence line**, ⭐⭐ **but did not clone, install R or its dependencies, run `00_run_all.R` or any script, obtain, build or run the AIDA and TIX C++ binaries, read any script under `R/`, inspect `figures/` or `data/`, or read the thesis**, so **its AIDA and TIX invocation details, the concrete implementation of feature construction, its parameter settings and its thesis conclusions cannot be restated**; **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its Findings section carries an explicit placeholder notice, and one value is written verbatim as an unresolved choice `[0.27 / 0.29 — reconcile]`** — **so the entry treats no figure in that section as a conclusion**, **recording that section only as the author’s argument structure and interpretation**; **the figures must await the final thesis, which was not read**; **④ ⭐⭐⭐ The claims that the two detectors disagree almost completely and that AUC is ≈ 0.46 were not verified** — **nothing was run**; **the author’s reading that AUC 0.46 should be understood as complementarity rather than failure is recorded faithfully as the author’s reading, and the entry does not claim it must hold (0.46 is literally close to no discrimination)**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether the pipeline’s "drop post-hoc outcome fields to prevent leakage" and "keep snapshot revision history as features" steps are implemented as described was not verified**; **⑥ ⭐⭐ The robustness of the finding that missingness carries signal was not verified** (**missingness rates correlate with claims handling itself and may reflect case routing rather than fraud risk; this is the entry’s cautionary judgement, not the author’s**); **⑦ ⭐ What `data/` actually contains was not verified** (**the README says no data file or derived export is committed; the entry does not claim the directory is empty or otherwise — its contents were not listed**); **⑧ ⭐ The collaboration with an Asian motor insurer and an actuarial consultancy was not verified** (**the README discloses no organisation names, and the entry claims none is checkable**); **⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ Fraud detection engages automated judgement about individuals and the associated procedural and compliance requirements in most jurisdictions**; **the entry does not claim the pipeline is usable in any jurisdiction for real investigation decisions, claims handling or adverse action against individuals** (**its own framing is to give adjusters leads, not conclusions**); **⑩ ⭐ At ★0 and 0 forks, created and pushed the same day**, **attention is very low**, **so no methodological superiority or adoption is claimed**; **⑪ ⭐ No topics**; **⑫ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified** (**the README measurably is in English**). **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/aay-shar/aida-tix-anomaly-detection`, `/readme` and `/contents/` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 8,502-byte README read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim, including the problem statement, the weak-label-benchmark and "agreement and disagreement, not accuracy" sentences, the Findings placeholder notice, the eight-step pipeline, the data disclaimer, the reference and the licence line); `LICENSE` measured 404 on main; **nothing cloned or run, its C++ binaries not built, and the thesis not read**.
